一家人 — Reading Quiz 阅读理解

阅读故事后回答八道选择题和两道短答题。Listen to each question or answer using its speaker button. Complete all questions before submitting.

一、选择题 Multiple Choice (8)

1. 鞋爸爸、鞋妈妈和鞋宝宝在哪里睡着了？

Xié bàba, xié māma hé xié bǎobao zài nǎlǐ shuìzháo le?

Where did the shoe family fall asleep?

2. 碗爸爸、碗妈妈和碗宝宝在哪里睡着了？

Wǎn bàba, wǎn māma hé wǎn bǎobao zài nǎlǐ shuìzháo le?

Where did the bowl family fall asleep?

3. 鱼爸爸、鱼妈妈和鱼宝宝在哪里睡着了？

Yú bàba, yú māma hé yú bǎobao zài nǎlǐ shuìzháo le?

Where did the fish family fall asleep?

4. 熊爸爸、熊妈妈和熊宝宝在哪里睡着了？

Xióng bàba, xióng māma hé xióng bǎobao zài nǎlǐ shuìzháo le?

Where did the bear family fall asleep?

5. 书爸爸、书妈妈和书宝宝在哪里睡着了？

Shū bàba, shū māma hé shū bǎobao zài nǎlǐ shuìzháo le?

Where did the book family fall asleep?

6. 牙刷爸爸、牙刷妈妈和牙刷宝宝在哪里睡着了？

Yáshuā bàba, yáshuā māma hé yáshuā bǎobao zài nǎlǐ shuìzháo le?

Where did the toothbrush family fall asleep?

7. 妈妈问小乐乐什么？

Māma wèn Xiǎo Lèlè shénme?

What did Mom ask Little Lele?

8. 故事最后，谁是一家人？

Gùshi zuìhòu, shéi shì yì jiā rén?

Who is a family at the end of the story?

二、简答题 Short Answers (2)

9. 故事里有哪些不同的“一家人”？请写出两种。

Gùshi lǐ yǒu nǎxiē bùtóng de “yì jiā rén”? Qǐng xiě chū liǎng zhǒng.

What different families appear in the story? Name two.

10. 你最喜欢故事里的哪一家？他们在哪里睡觉？

Nǐ zuì xǐhuan gùshi lǐ de nǎ yì jiā? Tāmen zài nǎlǐ shuìjiào?

Which family in the story do you like best? Where do they sleep?
